name: com.gameframex.unity.mono
description:
GameFrameX Mono — Unity MonoBehaviour lifecycle bridge package. Exposes Update, FixedUpdate, LateUpdate, Destroy, OnApplicationPause, and OnApplicationFocus events to non-MonoBehaviour systems via a listener registration pattern with event args dispatch. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Mono — Unity MonoBehaviour 生命周期桥接功能包。将 Update、FixedUpdate、LateUpdate、Destroy、OnApplicationPause 和 OnApplicationFocus 事件通过监听器注册模式暴露给非 MonoBehaviour 系统，并分发事件参数。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
